title: Mustard Floral Print Cotton Anarkali Suit Set with Kota Doria Dupatta
color_custom: Mustard yellow with red, rust and grey floral print
description:
Swarna means “gold” – warm mustard florals that glow like sunshine.

Warm mustard cotton printed all over with rich floral blooms in red, rust and grey. This Anarkali falls into soft gathers from the yoke, with full sleeves and a V-neckline finished with delicate hand embroidery. A light Kota Doria dupatta with patch work completes a look made for haldi, mehndi, Diwali puja and festive days.

✦ The Details
• Flared cotton Anarkali with gathered yoke
• V-neckline with hand embroidery
• Full-length sleeves
• Matching printed cotton pants
• Mustard Kota Doria dupatta with patch work and tassels
• 3-piece set: Anarkali, pants and dupatta

✦ Fabric & Craft
The Anarkali and pants are soft, breathable cotton, comfortable for long day functions. The dupatta is Kota Doria, the airy checked weave from Rajasthan, finished with patch work motifs.

✦ Fit & Size
Regular fit through the bodice with a full flare below. Choose your usual size or use our Fit Finder. Between sizes? Size up, or message us on WhatsApp.

✦ How to Style It
Oxidised silver jhumkas, a bindi and gold juttis or block heels. Perfect for haldi and mehndi, where yellow is the colour of the day.

✦ The Bahe Promise
• Made in our own unit in Jaipur, with photos of your piece before it ships
• Free shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE and Australia, duties prepaid, with tracking
• Real people on WhatsApp to help with size and styling

The colour may look slightly different on your screen.
care: Gentle hand wash in cold water or dry clean. Wash the dupatta separately. Dry in shade.
